sourceItems.title: 关于进一步深化燃煤发电上网电价市场化改革的通知
normalizedClaims: All coal-fired generation would progressively enter the power market; market transaction prices could move up or down by up to 20%, with high-energy-consumption users exempt from the upward cap.

sourceItems.title: China coal prices plunge from record high as govt considers intervention
normalizedClaims: Thermal-coal futures fell from record levels after the state planner signaled intervention to return coal prices to a reasonable range during the power crunch.

sourceItems.title: China coal prices notch worst week since May on govt intervention
normalizedClaims: Thermal-coal futures fell nearly 30% from the week's record as Beijing intensified supply/price intervention.

sourceItems.title: High lithium costs start to feed into prices of China EV batteries
normalizedClaims: China lithium-carbonate prices had risen more than 300% year over year as supply lagged unexpectedly strong EV demand; higher raw-material costs were beginning to feed into battery prices.

sourceItems.title: China vehicle sales fall for seventh month in prolonged chip shortage
normalizedClaims: November overall vehicle sales fell 9.1% YoY, but NEV sales rose 121% to about 450,000 units; industry commentary said consumer acceptance had shifted toward demand-driven adoption.
observedChanges: NEV demand remains exceptionally strong despite weak overall autos

sourceItems.title: Driven by NEVs, Power Battery Demand for Cathode Materials Forecast to Exceed 2.15 Million Tons in 2025
normalizedClaims: EVs accounted for over 60% of lithium-battery consumption; 2021 China NEV sales through November reached about 2.99m and power-battery installation grew rapidly. Cathode capacity expansion was expected over the following two to three years.

sourceItems.title: DRAM Prices Projected to Enter Period of Downswing in 2022 as Demand Lags Behind Supply
normalizedClaims: DRAM contract prices were expected to decline 3-8% QoQ in Q4 and enter a 2022 downswing as buyer procurement weakened and inventories rose.

sourceItems.title: 2021年1—11月份全国规模以上工业企业利润同比增长38.0%
normalizedClaims: Jan-Nov mining profits +186% YoY, oil/gas +284%, coal mining +223%, while power/heat production and supply profits fell 38.6%.

sourceItems.title: China central bank says to promote healthy development of property market
normalizedClaims: PBOC signaled marginal easing toward the property market and said it would better satisfy reasonable housing demand, but this did not establish a developer-level sales or cash-flow recovery.

sourceItems.title: 2021年12月中国采购经理指数运行情况
normalizedClaims: December manufacturing PMI rose to 50.3 as commodity-price pressure eased, but new orders remained below 50 at 49.7.

eventClusters.statement: China simultaneously widened coal-fired generation's tariff flexibility and intervened to crush record thermal-coal prices, creating a potentially durable repair in thermal-power unit economics after severe fuel-cost pressure.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Power-sector profits were still deeply negative through November. The reform improves the revenue/cost mechanism, but High-priority requires a company where the full normalized earnings/cash path is credibly repaired rather than merely a policy headline.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which listed thermal generator had the most durable tariff/fuel-spread path improvement with acceptable balance-sheet and expectation burden?

eventClusters.statement: NEV demand remained exceptionally strong while lithium prices rose more than 300% and battery costs began increasing; long-term cathode demand was structural but capacity expansion created a future supply-response question.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Structural demand is strong, but upstream scarcity profits may already imply long-duration high prices while battery/OEM margins face input inflation. The full earnings path must distinguish persistent demand from temporary scarcity rent.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there an A-share lithium/battery expression where the next/later earnings path improves beyond the already-known scarcity baseline?

eventClusters.statement: DRAM exited a three-quarter upcycle into falling contract prices as buyer inventories rose and procurement weakened, making forward physical evidence explicitly worse despite strong backward-looking semiconductor earnings.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: This is a negative cycle signal and single specialist origin. Do not bottom-fish using stale earnings; require company-specific resilience or a genuine turning-point bridge.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does any listed memory company have a sufficiently differentiated durable path to justify selection during an explicit physical downturn?

eventClusters.statement: Property policy tone turned marginally more supportive in late December, but the signal did not yet prove a developer-level sales, margin, liquidity or cash-flow recovery.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Policy support can reduce tail risk without creating equity value if operating cash flow and sales remain weak.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Reject generic property-long mapping until direct company economics improve.

eventClusters.statement: Manufacturing PMI recovered modestly as commodity-price pressure eased, but new orders remained below 50 and broad demand was not yet strong.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Useful as macro timing and cost-pressure context, not a narrow stock-selection thesis.
